goal: Prevent descriptor imports from deriving and tracking keys below the requested range start
Fix wallet state inconsistencies where out-of-range keys are treated as owned until restart
Avoid excessive derivation times and redundant re-expansions during descriptor import
agreement: Strong support with no open objections
Verified reload consistency and reproduced import speedup on regtest (fametrano)
Confirmed the functional test fails without the fix and passes with it on macOS (cprkrn)

categories.name: wallet
why: P2 because it fixes keys below range start being misidentified as owned until wallet restart
Prevents deriving up to 2^31 keys on high range starts and dramatically speeds up imports
